mods.description: Certified spider-free. Side effects may include: cats, meowing.

releases.notes:
## Better With Arachnophobia 1.0.0

First release. Every spider in BTA is now a photograph of a real cat, following you with its eyes and meowing.

### ✨ Features
- Vanilla spider model replaced with a proper billboard cat sprite that always faces the camera
- 3 cat variants
- Meowing instead of hissing
- Cat screams on hurt, on death, and occasionally for no reason at all
- Meow footstep sounds while walking

### ⚙️ Requirements
- Minecraft: BTA 8.0.1
- HalpLibe: 6.1.4+8.0
- Fabric Loader: 0.18.4-bta.11
- Java 17

readmeSummary: An Arachnophobia mode for Better Than Adventure, inspired by the one in Satisfactory.
